description: Count windows by room. Each window is counted once against its primary room; default primary room is ToRoom with FromRoom fallback. Compatible with Revit 2020.

includeUnnamed.description: Whether unnamed placed rooms should be included.

includeWindowDetails.description: Whether to include window-level detail rows under each room.

level.description: Optional level name or unambiguous partial level name. If omitted, all placed rooms are considered.

primaryRoomSource.description: Which Revit window room relationship counts as the primary room. Default toRoom counts each window once using ToRoom, then falls back to FromRoom.

roomIds.description: Optional explicit Room ElementId list. Overrides level filtering for rooms.

name: get_room_window_counts
title: Count windows by room
